title: The Ballad of Mount Kyllang and Mount Symper
khasi_title: Ka Jingrwai U Lum Kyllang bad U Lum Symper
cultural_context: Recounts the famous mythological duel between two giant mountain brothers: U Lum Kyllang (a gigantic red granite dome monolith in West Khasi Hills) and U Lum Symper (a dramatic limestone mountain in Maharam). Jealous of each other's height, they hurled colossal boulders and chunks of earth at each other across the sky until Symper was scarred with deep pockmarks and Kyllang stood victorious and smooth.
lyrics_khasi:
U Lum Kyllang bad u Lum Symper,
Ki arlei kynrem ha ka Ri Khasi;
Ki la ialeh ban pyni bor,
Ban tip uba kham jrong halor pyrthei!

U Kyllang u la pynher ia ki mawsiang,
U Symper u la kyntait da ka khyndew;
Ki riat ki la kynkhih, ka bneng ka la sawa,
Haduh ba u Kyllang u la jop ha ka nam!

Hynrei mynta ki shong suk ha la ri,
Ki sakhi ia ka nam jong u Hynniewtrep!
lyrics_english:
Mount Kyllang and Mount Symper,
Two colossal brothers upon the Khasi hills;
They contended fiercely to prove their might,
To see who was tallest and proudest beneath the heavens!

Kyllang hurled massive granite boulders through the sky,
Symper flung back sods of red highland earth;
The ravines shook, the heavens echoed with the thunder,
Until Kyllang stood triumphant in enduring granite glory!

Yet today both mountains rest in peace across our land,
Eternal witnesses to the greatness of the Children of the Seven Huts!

stanzas.title: Ki Ar Kynrem (Two Giant Brothers)
stanzas.khasi:
U Lum Kyllang bad u Lum Symper,
Ki arlei kynrem ha ka Ri Khasi;
Ki la ialeh ban pyni bor,
Ban tip uba kham jrong halor pyrthei!
stanzas.english: Mount Kyllang and Mount Symper, two majestic peaks in Khasi land; contending in power to prove who was tallest upon the earth!

stanzas.title: Ka Jingiatur Maw (Hurling of Boulders)
stanzas.khasi:
U Kyllang u la pynher ia ki mawsiang,
U Symper u la kyntait da ka khyndew;
Ki riat ki la kynkhih, ka bneng ka la sawa,
Haduh ba u Kyllang u la jop ha ka nam!
stanzas.english: Kyllang hurled giant stones, Symper returned mud and earth; gorges trembled and heavens echoed until Kyllang stood victorious!

vocabulary.lum kyllang: Colossal granite rock dome (over 5,600 ft) in West Khasi Hills
vocabulary.lum symper: Famous jagged limestone mountain peak in Maharam Syiemship
vocabulary.pynher maw: To hurl or launch giant stone boulders through the air in ancient warfare
vocabulary.hynniewtrep: The primordial Seven Celestial Families who populated the Khasi Hills
